payload.message:
Work in C:\Users\Veritas\.openclaw\workspace.

Objective: run the WF85/WF67 paper-deployment Telegram radar as a delivery-only readiness notification. This sends Randall a rich Telegram status for deployment-ready-for-review, near-deployment, watch, and blocked/repair states. It must never approve, submit, cancel, sell, replace, modify, or route paper/live orders.

Execute exactly this single command:
python scripts\wf85_paper_deployment_telegram_cron_runner.py --send --write --validate

Required clean posture:
- runner status ok and validation ok
- digest status ok
- notifier status SENT, NO_REPLY, DRY_RUN_READY, or BLOCKED with explicit blocker proof
- execution_ready_count remains 0 unless a separate exact WF67 order approval path and fresh guard/kill-switch proof exist
- all authority flags remain false for capital deployment approval, trade/execution approval, paper/live execution, brokerage/account action, money movement, canon/portfolio mutation, cash/sizing/risk-rule mutation, and owner approval inference

Response contract: reply exactly NO_REPLY if the command exits 0. If blocked, report only the failing step and artifact path.

Boundaries: Telegram delivery only. REVIEW/PREPARE may lead to inspection/request preparation; APPROVE is not active in Telegram. No paper/live submit, cancel, sell, replace, modify, close-position, liquidation, transfer, or approval action; no live endpoint or live credentials; no brokerage/account mutation or money movement; no portfolio/canon/sizing/sleeve/cash/risk-rule mutation; no customer/public delivery; no owner approval inference. Paper execution still requires Randall exact order approval, fresh WF67 guard validation, fresh short-lived kill switch, WF67 wrapper-only paper endpoint execution, redacted audit, and GET-only reconciliation.
